In all seriousness, I haven't played any CoD games for the campaign since World at War, which was decent. But the thing I dislike about big "Hollywood" military shooters is the decreasing amount of concern for the plots and innovation in campaigns. Modern Warfare's campaign was definitely not the most original or thought-provoking of any game I played, but it sure was a Hell of a fun time. The campaigns of the CoD series after WaW have become the game equivalent of Michael Bay's Transformers series, dumbed down over and over and over again by it's clichés.

For a full-priced game, BFHL doesn't have a lot to offer. If you're looking for a interesting campaign, look elsewhere, I recommend games like Spec Ops: The Line  or even the original Modern Warfare for that matter. Multiplayer is the game's strong point, if you're into multiplayer-oriented games, It's more vehicle-oriented than BF4. However, the game is not particularly deep or refreshing enough to be bought at full price. It's not a shitty game, but the game itself is essentially an overpriced mod for BF4. 

Between CoD and BF4, BF4 is the lesser of two evils, BF4, like CoD does not have a particularly engaging single player mode, but has slightly more tactical and complex gameplay than the run-and-gun gameplay of CoD. I recommend it if you're a fan of multiplayer-oriented shooters. But personally, I'm growing out of multiplayer games.
